findings.issue: Hophal perfect 3ms (completed: was made known) is rendered with future subjunctive hiciere, adding conditional/prospective mood the perfect does not mark. Passive causative sense, 3ms, and the to-him suffix stay intact.

notes: Other tokens match: or, to him, his sin which he sinned (twice), and he shall bring his offering, she-goat of goats, whole, female, upon.
